summary: King Resources, Inc. (formerly OneSolution Technology Inc.) filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary Heavenly Grace Limited entered into a Purchase Agreement with Herbertini Limited to acquire 23 collectible ceramics for US$23,399,165, to be settled in KRFG common stock at $0.23 per share. This is an ordinary asset purchase contract, not a transformative corporate event affecting shareholders. The filing contains no change of control, merger, tender offer, or activist activity. It is merely a material definitive agreement disclosure. Investors should monitor delivery and valuation of the collectibles, but no special-situation or risk-arbitrage angle exists.
